ontology.note: Emits fw:PointBuffer with the source point, the radius as a QUDT quantity and the fraction of the true circle area the polygon covers. The output is fw:StudyArea: a derived scope is still a scope, and the derivation rather than the class is what distinguishes it from a surveyed boundary.

changes.description: Defines a study area as everything within a stated distance of one named point, which previously existed only welded inside Select nearby facilities. One named point only: the bounding box of several distant points makes a raster window too coarse to sample, measured as a 1,469 m cell across three Philippine gauges against 19 m for one 5 km scope. Refuses an unknown or unlocated point and never unions several.

evidence.note: Five unit checks cover the circle approximation against the true area, naming a point by id or by name, the recorded source point and radius with its unit, refusal of blank, unknown and unlocated points, and the distance bound. The radius is an assumption of the question and no threshold is established as defensible; see docs/experiments/68-area-around-a-point.md. Composition is established by tests/composition-elevation.test.mjs, which wires this to Clip raster and Sample raster at points and shows that a tighter scope windows the grid, so an uncovered facility is reported as outside the raster rather than as no-data.
